name: cyclops-spark
description: Spark, Claude's living presence for the terminal: a small procedural creature drawn only from real Claude Code session events, as half-block cells or kitty/Ghostty pixels.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Spark's temperament of colour. Error is red in every palette. One of: spark, aurora, ember, moon.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The ground Spark is drawn for. 'auto' follows your Claude Code theme (and a plain 'auto' theme there counts as dark). One of: auto, dark, light.

welcome.title: Welcome eye
welcome.description: When a session starts, the Cyclops eye is drawn above the prompt until your first message, then the room is given back.

rollTitle.title: Title card on the roll
rollTitle.description: Open /spark convert roll with a title card: the Cyclops eye, the title (the name you gave the conversation with /rename, or the project's folder; or /spark convert roll ... called <a title>), the date, how many paintings and the music's key.

rollMusic.title: Music in the roll
rollMusic.description: Give /spark convert roll its own instrumental music, read from the paintings: the session's colours pick the key, each painting a chord, each mark laid down a note. No tokens. Off: a silent clip.

hd.title: HD cells
hd.description: Draw Spark and her paintings four pixels to a cell (quadrant blocks) instead of two (half blocks), in any terminal: finer lines, the same light. Off is the look before 1.7.2.

calm.title: Calm
calm.description: No ambient breathing or drift anywhere. Real events still draw.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Soft cues for real events: a long turn landing, an error, a refusal. 'full' adds wake, mend, compaction and a copied reply. Plays on macOS and Linux. One of: off, soft, full.

chimeAfterSeconds.title: Chime after (seconds)
chimeAfterSeconds.description: A turn must run at least this long before its landing is chimed in 'soft' mode, so quick turns stay quiet.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show Spark's glyph and truthful state line in the status line.

murmur.title: Murmur
murmur.description: Quiet sounds while the model really streams: a low hum while it thinks, soft bubbles while it writes. Plays on macOS and Linux.

band.title: Top strip at start
band.description: Show Spark in the short strip above the prompt from the moment a session starts, without typing /spark top. Useful in small terminals.

link.title: Cyclops Link
link.description: Let Spark notice Keeper (Codex) and Prism (Antigravity) working in the same folder, and let them notice her. She shares only her coarse state, her counts of calls and branches, and whom she is calling; never prompts, commands, paths or names. Needs python3. Off by default.

paint.title: Painter
paint.description: A small painter (a sub-agent, Haiku by default) paints Spark's expression of each turn in the room below her side pane. It sees the turn's shape (how long, which kinds of tools, failures, how much was written) and a short excerpt of the reply (at most 600 characters); never your prompt, paths or commands. In a long turn it also paints while the turn goes, at most every 15 minutes, from a short reflection on how the build feels, distilled from Claude's own last words aloud (at most 200 characters, never the work itself). Each painting is one short model call through your session (a live one two small ones) and uses tokens (shown under the painting: that painting's own cost and the session's total). /spark paint turns it on, /spark paint off stops it. Off by default.

paintModel.title: Painter model
paintModel.description: The model that paints: an alias such as haiku or sonnet, or a full model id.

openPainting.title: Paint when Spark opens
openPainting.description: When on, opening Spark with /spark (or /spark side) also turns the painter on: one command for both. The painter uses tokens. Off by default.

sideWidth.title: Side pane width
sideWidth.description: How many columns wide the side pane opens (24 to 120), so it opens the size you like every time. 0 is automatic: a quarter of the terminal, 30 to 44 columns. A size you drag still wins for that session.

convertFolder.title: Convert folder
convertFolder.description: Where /spark convert writes the large SVG and PNG of a painting (and an index.html gallery). Relative to the project you are working in, or an absolute path. Spark writes there only when you run the command.

convertCaption.title: Caption on converted paintings
convertCaption.description: Write the painting's title, and a small line (Spark, the date, the way it was made), on the picture itself under the painting. On by default.
